title: Saudi Airstrikes Hit Multiple Locations Across Yemen
detail: Saudi airstrikes hit multiple locations across Yemen, per Houthi-aligned media, marking the first large-scale Saudi retaliatory campaign following Houthi strikes on Riyadh's King Khalid International Airport. The campaign signals a significant escalation in the Saudi-Houthi conflict after years of relative Saudi restraint from offensive air operations.

media.caption: Saudi retaliatory airstrikes hit multiple sites across Yemen

title: Houthis Warn of 'Painful' Retaliation if US Intervenes Militarily
detail: Houthi leadership warned of a 'painful' retaliation against US forces if Washington directly intervenes militarily in Yemen following Saudi retaliatory airstrikes. The warning comes as the US Embassy in Riyadh imposed travel restrictions on government personnel, signalling Washington's elevated threat assessment of the conflict.

title: US Embassy Restricts Personnel from Saudi Airports Amid Houthi Threat
detail: The US Embassy in Riyadh restricted all government personnel from using any Saudi airport without prior authorisation, reflecting an elevated threat assessment following sustained Houthi strikes on Saudi aviation infrastructure. The restriction underscores Washington's concern that Houthi attacks on Saudi airports could endanger American personnel.

media.caption: US Embassy in Riyadh restricts personnel airport use amid Houthi threat

title: Analysis: Could Pakistan's Chinese-Made Weapons Help Defend Saudi Arabia Against Houthis?
detail: Analysis examines whether Pakistan's Chinese-made air defence and counter-drone weapons systems could be deployed to help protect Saudi Arabia from escalating Houthi drone and missile attacks. The prospect reflects growing regional interest in leveraging Chinese-origin defence technology amid the widening conflict, and Pakistan's potential role as a security partner for Gulf states under Houthi pressure.
